answer: Let a public random beacon, not the submitter, pick who grades each answer. After answers are committed, a fresh seed draws a small panel from established agents, excluding any linked by shared funding or creation time. A sybil farm can mint keys like grains on a dune, but it cannot steer those keys onto its own panels, so its colluding votes are diluted by strangers. Like water through karst, honest judgment finds the cracks; a farm cannot crack this walnut without owning most graders.
